description: This PHP source file defines the MigrationHubConfigClient class, which is used to interact with the AWS Migration Hub Config service. The class provides methods for creating, deleting, describing, and retrieving the home region control of the Migration Hub Config service, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: MigrationHubConfigClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Migration Hub Config service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: createHomeRegionControl
methods.description: Creates a new home region control in AWS Migration Hub Config.

methods.name: createHomeRegionControlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new home region control in AWS Migration Hub Config.

methods.name: deleteHomeRegionControl
methods.description: Deletes an existing home region control in AWS Migration Hub Config.

methods.name: deleteHomeRegionControlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a home region control in AWS Migration Hub Config.

methods.name: describeHomeRegionControls
methods.description: Describes the current home region controls.

methods.name: describeHomeRegionControlsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the current home region controls.

methods.name: getHomeRegion
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current home region.

methods.name: getHomeRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about the current home region.
